answer: Use cross-epoch fingerprint matching: a vault stores each identity’s per-epoch action fingerprint—timing and counterparty patterns. On renewal, the rule requires the next epoch’s fingerprint to stay within a tolerance calibrated from live dune data, rejecting copied histories. A sybil must pay to sustain a separate sparrow-like interaction trail for every epoch, with unique timing and counterparties, so N identities cost N maintained histories plus matching compute.
